lines.en: label rikaspring5:
scene noonsky
It’s easy to forget sometimes because of all the bullshit, but there’s an entire world with people in it that are doing stuff right now, and I think that’s pretty cool.
lines.zh: 被一堆破事缠着，人很容易忘记：此刻正有一整个世界、一整个世界的人，正在做着各自的事——而我觉得这相当酷。

lines.en: For example, while you’re off ironing your socks or organizing hot dog buns like regular people do, there’s someone in Iran or something hitting the Griddy, completely unaware of your existence.
lines.zh: 比如说，当你像普通人一样熨袜子、码热狗面包的时候，伊朗某地有个人正在跳 Griddy 舞，完全不知道你的存在。

lines.en: What is the “Griddy” you ask? I don’t know. Something young people do, I think. Or did. Keeping up with the Joneses is quite difficult when they’re spread out across various timelines.
lines.zh: 你问「Griddy」是什么？我不知道。好像是年轻人跳的舞。或者曾经跳。当「邻居们」散落在不同的时间线上，想跟上他们的潮流，是相当难的。

lines.en: But the point I’m trying to make here is simple. It’s that the world still moves without you. And once you stop moving, it’s not like it’s going to just follow your lead.
lines.zh: 但我想说的重点很简单：世界离开你照样转动。而一旦你停下，它可不会跟着你的节奏走。

lines.en: Or maybe it will. And maybe Matt Damon was right when he wrote that thing about eggs in Project Hail Mary. Maybe you’re not you and you’re actually me and we’re all just us together?
lines.zh: 又或者它会。也许 Matt Damon 在《挽救计划》里写的那段关于鸡蛋的话是对的。也许你不是你、你其实是我，而我们全都是「我们」，合在一起？

lines.en: Whatever the case, I think you should live each day knowing that it could be the last chance you ever get to hit the Griddy.
lines.zh: 无论如何，我认为你应该把每一天，都当作「最后一次跳 Griddy 的机会」来活。

lines.en: Here’s looking at you, Casablanca.
lines.zh: 看着你呢，卡萨布兰卡。

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom1
: Did Otoha really write this?...
lines.zh: : 这真的是 Otoha 写的?……

lines.en: : It’s, like...actually good...
lines.zh: : 这……写得……真好……

lines.en: : It’s easy to forget because Nodoka exists, but Otoha’s a creative genius as well. You should have seen some of the stuff she was coming up with in our old school.
lines.zh: : 因为 Nodoka 的存在,大家容易忘记,Otoha 同样是个创意天才。你该看看她在我们老学校时想出的那些东西。

lines.en: : Is that...why she was so popular over there?...
lines.zh: : 那……她在那边那么受欢迎,就是因为这个?……

lines.en: : No. Well, maybe a little. I think it was just mostly because she’s hot and cool and wears a lot of rings.
lines.zh: : 不是。嗯,也许有一点。我觉得主要还是因为她火辣、够酷,还戴了一手戒指。

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom2
: You guys know I can hear you, right? You’re not even trying to whisper.
lines.zh: : 你们知道我听得见吧?你们连装模作样的耳语都懒得。

lines.en: : Otoha, how many of these songs are about my sister?
lines.zh: : Otoha,这些歌里有几首是写我姐的?

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom3
: Uhh, none?! What?! Why would you...how did you...
lines.zh: : 呃,零首?!什么?!你为什么会……你怎么……

lines.en: : It’s kind of obvious once you know Niki as a person.
lines.zh: : 只要认识 Niki 这个人,这就很明显了。

lines.en: : You keep referencing things about her that only people like me, Sensei, and I guess you would understand. It’s cute. I never realized how bad you were down for her before.
lines.zh: : 你一直引用只有我、Sensei、大概还有你才懂的她的事。很可爱。我从没意识到你为她沦陷得这么深。

lines.en: : I’m not “down bad” at all! It’s probably just a coincidence!
lines.zh: : 我才没有「沦陷」!那多半只是巧合!

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom4
: I’m confused. Why would Sensei be familiar with Niki? That doesn’t make any sense.
lines.zh: : 我糊涂了。为什么 Sensei 会熟悉 Niki?这讲不通啊。

lines.en: : Chika, come on. Has it really not clicked yet or are you just being delusional on purpose?
lines.zh: : Chika,拜托。这事你还没想通吗?还是你在故意装糊涂?

lines.en: : Has what not clicked yet? What are you talking about? Also, as the admin of her third most popular fanpage, chances are I know just as much about her as-
lines.zh: : 什么没想通?你在说什么?还有,作为她第三大粉丝页的管理员,我对她的了解不比谁少——

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom5
: Hi! So, now that practice is finally over, can you please just-
lines.zh: : 嗨!那么,练习终于结束了,能不能麻烦你们——

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom6
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
scene rikarinmusicroom7
: J-J-J-J-J-J-JUST REMEMBERED I HAVE TO...SHOES! BYE!
lines.zh: : 我、我、我、我、我、我突然想起来我得去……拿鞋!拜!

lines.en: : Oh, come on! What good is “see you in school” if you’re just going to do this every time we’re here!
lines.zh: : 哦,拜托!「学校见」的意义在哪——反正你们一到社团你就这样!

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom8
: CAN’T HEAR YOU! SHOES!
lines.zh: : 听!不!见!鞋!

lines.en: : YOU CAN’T RUN FROM ME FOREVER, CHOSOKABE! I WILL FIND YOU!
lines.zh: : 你逃不掉我一辈子的,长曾我部!我会找到你的!

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom9
: What’s going on with Chika? Why does she need to “shoes” so urgently?
lines.zh: : Chika 怎么了?她为什么急着要去「拿鞋」?

lines.en: : She’s just embarrassed after finally shooting her shot with Rin only to have the gun misfire and take her whole fucking hand off.
lines.zh: : 她终于向 Rin 表白,结果枪卡壳,把自己的整只手都崩飞了,现在羞得没脸见人。

lines.en: : “Shoot your shot” is a reference to basketball. There are no guns involved, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 「Shoot your shot」指的是篮球。没有枪,Otoha。

lines.en: : Basketball’s an American sport, isn’t it? There are probably guns involved. We just don’t know about them.
lines.zh: : 篮球不是美国运动吗?那多半有枪。只是我们不知道。

lines.en: : There goes Otoha and her racism again...
lines.zh: : Otoha 的种族歧视言论又来了……

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom10
: Stop calling me a racist! My teacher is black!
lines.zh: : 别叫我种族歧视!我的老师是黑人!

lines.en: : I see...So Chika finally shot her shot with Rin...and the gun misfired...
lines.zh: : 我懂了……所以 Chika 终于向 Rin 表白了……然后枪卡壳了……

lines.en: : (Computing)
lines.zh: : (运算中)

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom11
: (Still computing)
lines.zh: : (仍在运算)

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom12
: Psst. I think it’s your line.
lines.zh: : 嘘。我觉得轮到你接话了。

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom13
: Wait! Chika confessed to you and you turned her down?!?!?! And I didn’t know about it?!?!?!
lines.zh: : 等等!Chika 向你告白了,而你拒绝了?!?!?!而我居然不知道?!?!?!

lines.en: : If you don’t want to tell me because I’m your mom, fine! But at least have the courtesy to tell me as your club advisor!
lines.zh: : 你不想告诉我,因为你是我的妈妈,行!但至少作为你的社团顾问,你有义务告诉我吧!

lines.en: : I don’t want to do either of those things! I can handle this on my own and you’re just going to make it weird!
lines.zh: : 我哪样都不想!我自己能处理,你只会把事情搞怪!

lines.en: : But I can make it weird in the hallway! I don’t have to do it in front of your friends!
lines.zh: : 但我可以在走廊里搞怪!我不必当着你朋友的面搞!

lines.en: : Mom, stop! This is hard enough without you breathing down my neck about it!
lines.zh: : 妈,住手!这件事本来就够难了,你还在这喘不上气地催!

lines.en: : Tell me what happened and I’ll give you your phone back!
lines.zh: : 告诉我发生了什么,我就把手机还你!

lines.en: : Hallway. Now.
lines.zh: : 走廊。现在。

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom14
: Daughter.
lines.zh: : 女儿。

lines.en: : Mother...
lines.zh: : 妈妈……

lines.en: : Tell me the tales of your lesbian woes so that I can help you and feel better about mine.
lines.zh: : 把你蕾丝边的悲哀 tale 讲给我听,好让我帮你,顺便让我对自己的悲哀好受一点。

lines.en: : They’re not really woes at all...Chika just told me she likes me and that she can’t hang out with me anymore because of it.
lines.zh: : 其实根本算不上悲哀……Chika 只是告诉我她喜欢我,而且因为这样,她不能再和我一起玩了。

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom15
: What? Why? Is it like another Otoha thing where she just doesn’t want her parents to find out?
lines.zh: : 什么?为什么?是不是又是一个 Otoha 式的「不想让父母知道」?

lines.en: : Otoha lied about that, Mom. She was the one embarrassed, not her parents. Also, Chika doesn’t have parents. Remember?
lines.zh: : Otoha 那个是撒谎,妈。尴尬的是她,不是她父母。另外,Chika 没有父母。记得吗?

lines.en: : Two things: shame on Otoha, condolences to Chika.
lines.zh: : 两件事:Otoha 该羞愧;向 Chika 致哀。

lines.en: : Why can’t she hang out with you though? You guys have been inseparable lately. I already started planning the wedding.
lines.zh: : 可她为什么不能和你玩了?你们最近好得形影不离。婚礼我都开始策划了。

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom16
: Where?! Gay marriage isn’t legal here!
lines.zh: : 在哪办?!同性婚姻在这里不合法!

lines.en: : First rule of lesbians, Rin — there is always a hole. In this case a loophole. I’ll figure it out. Just worry about filling the hole. The other one. Without the loop.
lines.zh: : 蕾丝边第一法则,Rin——永远有一个「洞」。在这个案例里,是「漏洞」。我会解决的。你只管去填你的「洞」。另一个。不带环的那种。

lines.en: : Mom, I don’t like Chika like that anymore! I just want her to keep being my friend because I miss her and care about her!
lines.zh: : 妈,我已经不喜欢 Chika 那样了!我只想让她继续当我的朋友,因为我想她、我在乎她!

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom17
: Rin...you liked her for years. I know those feelings aren’t just gone. What happened?
lines.zh: : Rin……你喜欢她好几年了。我知道那些感情不会凭空消失。发生什么了?

lines.en: : Did you reject her? Is that why she can’t hang out with you? Will she if you accept? Do you not even want to try?
lines.zh: : 是你拒绝了她吗?所以她不能和你玩?你接受的话她就会来吗?你甚至不想试一次?

lines.en: : I do but...there’s...
lines.zh: : 我想过但是……有……

lines.en: : There’s somebody else I like more, okay?
lines.zh: : 有一个我更喜欢的新人,行吗?

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom18
: What? Who? Noriko? I bet it’s Noriko. You guys would be adorable together. Or maybe Sana! A little small, sure. But I get it.
lines.zh: : 什么?谁?Noriko?我打赌是 Noriko。你们俩在一起会 adorable 死。或者是 Sana!个子小了点,没错。但我懂。

lines.en: : It’s no one from the club, mom.
lines.zh: : 不是社团里的人,妈。

lines.en: : Molly. Futaba. God, I hope it’s not Futaba. She’s too sweet for this family. Yumi! Uhh...Touka! You’re a gold digger! Don’t do it, Rin!
lines.zh: : Molly。Futaba。天,千万别是 Futaba。她太甜了,不适合我们家。Yumi!呃……Touka!你是捞女!别去,Rin!

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom19
: It’s no one from class either, Mom. Or school in general.
lines.zh: : 也不是班里的人,妈。或者干脆说,不是学校里的任何人。

lines.en: : Don’t tell me you like Noriko’s sister too. What’s Otoha going to think?
lines.zh: : 别告诉我你连 Noriko 的姐姐也喜欢。那让 Otoha 怎么想?

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom20
: What does that stare mean? You know I’m bad with interpreting facial expressions.
lines.zh: : 你那个眼神是什么意思?你知道我不擅长解读表情。

lines.en: : I’m just waiting for you to figure it out since I think it’d be kind of obvious given somewhat recent developments.
lines.zh: : 我在等你自己想通——因为鉴于最近的一些进展,这答案应该挺明显的。

lines.en: : Recent developments...
lines.zh: : 最近的进展……

lines.en: : (Computing)
lines.zh: : (运算中)

lines.en: : I’m hungry. Can I run to the vending machine while your brain is stuck loading?
lines.zh: : 我饿了。趁你的大脑卡在加载界面,我能跑去自动贩卖机吗?

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom21
: Rin...you’re not talking about Sensei again, are you?
lines.zh: : Rin……你说的不会又是 Sensei 吧?

lines.en: : Ding ding ding. Turns out taking my phone away didn’t magically cure me of liking him. Who would’ve thought?
lines.zh: : 叮叮叮。原来没收我的手机,并不能魔法般地治好我对他的喜欢。谁能想到呢?

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom22
: It wasn’t supposed to cure you! But I figured that him letting you down and telling you he wasn’t interested in girls your age would have been all you needed to move on!
lines.zh: : 那本来就不是为了「治好」你!我以为,他拒绝你、告诉你他对你这个年纪的女孩没兴趣,就足够让你往前走了!

lines.en: : Oh. Right. Yeah. He definitely did that. And it was completely natural and didn’t make me suspect you had anything to do with it at all.
lines.zh: : 哦。对。嗯。他的确那样做了。而且自然得不得了,完全没让我怀疑到你头上。

lines.en: : And it changed nothing?! You still like him? He’s old enough to be your father...ish.
lines.zh: : 而且这什么都没改变?!你还喜欢他?他的年纪都够当你爸了……差不多。

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom23
: Hey, maybe he is? It’s not like we actually know. And it’s not like even that would change anything at this point given how I’ve already made up my mind.
lines.zh: : 嘿,说不定真是呢?反正我们也不知道。而且就算那样,到了这一步也改变不了任何事——我已经下定决心了。

lines.en: : So...you’ve made up your mind to the point where finding out he’s your biological father still wouldn’t make you reconsider?
lines.zh: : 所以……你已经下定决心到「就算发现他是你的生父也不会 reconsider」的程度了?

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom24
: I don’t know. It works for Ami, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。Ami 那边不是运作得挺好吗?

lines.en: : Does it?
lines.zh: : 是吗?

lines.en: : Sometimes. When she’s not threatening to kill us.
lines.zh: : 有时候。在她不威胁杀我们的时候。

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom25
: Rin, I’m not okay with this. And neither is Akira. And I get that your feelings are strong, but all you’re doing by continuing to go after him is making things harder for both of you.
lines.zh: : Rin,我不同意。Akira 也不同意。我理解你的感情很强烈,但你继续追他,只会让你们俩都更难。

lines.en: : Isn’t that good, though? Won’t it just make me stronger if I wind up getting hurt again? Like what happened with Chika and Otoha. And even you with Mom.
lines.zh: : 可那不是好事吗?如果我再次受伤,不只会让我更坚强吗?就像 Chika 和 Otoha 那样。甚至像你和妈妈那样。

lines.en: : I am a lot of things without your mother, but “strong” is not one of them.
lines.zh: : 没有你妈妈,我身上有很多东西,但「坚强」不在其列。

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom26
: You’re holding down a job. You have your own apartment now. You’ve even learned how to do laundry.
lines.zh: : 你在工作。你有自己的公寓了。你甚至学会洗衣服了。

lines.en: : Mostly. I still need Imani’s help with that sometimes.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。有时我还是需要 Imani 帮忙。

lines.en: : Okay, fine. Then you’re almost capable of doing laundry. But you’re still in a much better spot now than you were a few years ago.
lines.zh: : 好,行。那你是「几乎会洗衣服」了。但你的处境,也比几年前好太多了。

lines.en: : Not mentally. Or physically for that matter. Just in status alone, and that doesn’t make me stronger, it just helps hide me from criticism.
lines.zh: : 精神上没有。身体上也没有。只有「身份」上好了,而那不会让我更强,只是帮我躲开批评。

lines.en: : So what’s the moral here then? Know when to quit? Is that what you’re trying to teach me?
lines.zh: : 那这里的寓意是什么?知道何时该放弃吗?这是你想教我的吗?

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom27
: I didn’t have a specific moral in mind but yeah, that sounds good. Know when to quit.
lines.zh: : 我本来没有具体的寓意,但听起来不错。知道何时该放弃。

lines.en: : Seems contradictory to the “never give up” message I’ve gotten in the past.
lines.zh: : 这和我过去听到的「永不放弃」有点自相矛盾。

lines.en: : Know when to quit but never give up. Sounds like a good yearbook quote. Do I get a yearbook quote? Don’t take that. I want to use it.
lines.zh: : 「知道何时放弃,但永不放弃。」这句毕业纪念册留言不错。我有资格写毕业留言吗?别抢。我要用这句。

lines.en: : Mom, I don’t care how many times you tell Sensei to turn me down. I still like him enough to not want anyone else, and there’s nothing you can do to change that.
lines.zh: : 妈,不管你让 Sensei 拒绝我多少次,我对他的喜欢都足以让我不想要任何人。你做什么都改变不了。

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom28
: You don’t know it was me who told him to do that. He could have decided that on his own. Which he probably did because that would be what a smart person does and he is a smart person.
lines.zh: : 你又不知道是他让我那么做的。他可能自己决定的。多半也是——因为聪明人就会那么做,而他是个聪明人。

lines.en: : It was definitely you who told him to do that. Sensei doesn’t “let people down,” Mom. He lets them drown in uncertainty forever because it’s easier than openly hurting them.
lines.zh: : 绝对是你让他那么做的。Sensei 不会「让人失望」,妈。他让人永远溺死在不确定里——因为那样比正面伤害他们容易。

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom29
: I know this because I’ve watched him for so long. He’s my best friend. And it’s okay that you think that’s weird, but nothing has happened between us. And that pisses me off.
lines.zh: : 我知道这个,是因为我观察他太久了。他是我最好的朋友。你觉得这很怪没关系,但我们之间什么都没有发生。而这件事让我火大。

lines.en: : So maybe I just need to be pissed off a little longer. Maybe that’s what will get me to rethink romance and fall back on Chika or Noriko or any of the people you want me to be with.
lines.zh: : 所以也许我需要再火大一阵子。也许那样我才会重新思考浪漫,回头投向 Chika、Noriko、或任何你希望我在一起的人。

lines.en: : But do you know what I have to say about that, Mom? About you thinking you can exercise this sort of authority to guide me down that path you want me to take?
lines.zh: : 但你知道我对此想说什么吗,妈?关于你觉得可以行使这种权威、把我引上你设计的那条路?

lines.en: : What?...What do you think?...
lines.zh: : 什么?……你觉得是什么?……

lines.en: : I think...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom30
: That’s not punk at all and you’re just a big loser! Beeeeeeh!
lines.zh: : 这一点都不朋克,你就是个大输家!咩————!

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom31
: Wha- where do you get off, young lady?!
lines.zh: : 什——你哪来的胆子,小姑娘?!

lines.en: : Hopefully Sensei’s house! Phbhbhbhhtt!!!!
lines.zh: : 最好是 Sensei 家!呸啊啊!!!!

lines.en: : I’m hanging onto your phone! You’re not getting it back now!
lines.zh: : 手机还在我这!你现在拿不回去了!

lines.en: : I already picked your pocket while you were lecturing me because I’m not a poser! Later, Mom!
lines.zh: : 你训我的时候,我已经把你口袋摸了——因为我可不是装朋克的假货!回见,妈!

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom32
: What the-
lines.zh: : 什么——

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom33
: God damn it. That was so fucking cool.
lines.zh: : 该死。这他妈太帅了。

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom34
: Imani, we have a problem. My daughter says I’m not punk anymore.
lines.zh: : Imani,我们有麻烦了。我女儿说我不朋克了。

lines.en: : Aren’t you a little too old to be fighting back against the establishment anyway? Maybe this is the wake-up call you need.
lines.zh: : 反抗体制这种事,你这年纪是不是太老了?也许这是你需要的当头棒喝。

lines.en: : Also, she wants to fuck Akira.
lines.zh: : 另外,她想睡 Akira。

lines.en: : So do you. And honestly, I’m surprised you haven’t yet.
lines.zh: : 你也想啊。而且说实话,你还没睡到他,我反而意外。

lines.en: : Sure, but maybe he wants to fuck her too!
lines.zh: : 也许,但他可能也想睡她呢!

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom35
: Wanting to and actually doing it are two different things. Do you have any proof that this has actually happened?
lines.zh: : 「想」和「真的做」是两回事。你有任何证据证明这事真的发生了吗?

lines.en: : No. In fact, Rin has confirmed to me that it has not.
lines.zh: : 没有。事实上,Rin 已经向我确认过没有。

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom36
: Great. So you have a horny daughter. I don’t see how this is my problem at all.
lines.zh: : 太好了。所以你有一个饥渴的女儿。我看不出这跟我有半毛钱关系。

lines.en: : The problem is that I told Akira to let Rin down so that she wouldn’t keep pursuing him and I don’t think he actually did!
lines.zh: : 问题在于,我让 Akira 拒绝 Rin、好让她别再追他——而我觉得他根本没有做!

lines.en: : Well, yeah. Senpai doesn’t “let people down.” He lets them drown in uncertainty forever because it’s easier than openly hurting them.
lines.zh: : 嗯,对。学姐不会「让人失望」。他让人永远溺死在不确定里,因为那样比正面伤害容易。

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom37
: GOD FUCKING DAMN IT! ARE WE EVEN FRIENDS?! WHY DOES EVERYONE KNOW THIS BUT ME?!
lines.zh: : 老天他妈的!!我们到底算不算朋友?!为什么除了我所有人都知道这件事?!

lines.en: : Is there anything else or can I get back to grading papers now?
lines.zh: : 还有别的吗?没有的话我回去改卷子了。

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom38
: Imani, when I was in ninth grade, the whole school started spreading rumors about me giving this dude named Take a handjob in the locker room. It lasted all the way until graduation.
lines.zh: : Imani,我九年级的时候,全校都在传我在更衣室里给一个叫 Take 的家伙用手。一直传到毕业。

lines.en: : Well...did you?
lines.zh: : 所以……你做了吗?

lines.en: : Yes! But that’s exactly the problem! Word doesn’t get around this intensely unless there’s some semblance of truth to it!
lines.zh: : 做了!但这恰恰是问题!这种强度的流言,不可能是凭空捏造的!

lines.en: : So if everyone is trying to jump Akira’s bones, which we clearly see they are, and he’s not turning them down, shouldn’t we be suspicious about that?!
lines.zh: : 所以,如果所有人都想扑倒 Akira——这明摆着——而他来者不拒,我们不该起疑心吗?!

lines.en: : You’re just now catching onto all of this?
lines.zh: : 你现在才反应过来?

lines.en: : Have you been suspicious the entire time then?! Has everyone?! What have we done about it?!
lines.zh: : 那你一直都在怀疑?!所有人都一直在怀疑?!我们都做了什么?!

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom39
: Hah...what can we do about it other than wait for somebody to slip up?
lines.zh: : 哈……除了等谁先露馅,我们还能做什么?

lines.en: : I obviously want to give Senpai the benefit of the doubt because I may or may not love him, but evidence isn’t evidence until it’s actually evidence, you know?
lines.zh: : 我显然想给学姐一个清白的机会——因为我「可能」爱他——但证据在成为证据之前,不是证据,你懂吧?

lines.en: : This really could just be mass hysteria at the end of the day. Regardless of the parade of red flags following him wherever he goes.
lines.zh: : 归根结底,这也许真的只是一场集体癔症。尽管他走到哪,身后都跟着一整队红旗。

lines.en: : Then there’s only one thing we can do.
lines.zh: : 那么只剩一件事可做。

lines.en: : Yeah? And what’s that?
lines.zh: : 是吗?什么事?

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom40
: We get that horse to open its mouth and speak.
lines.zh: : 我们让那匹马开口说话。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : We say, “Horse. Talk.” Then we point at the elephant in the room and wait for him to ride it outta there.
lines.zh: : 我们说:「马。说话。」然后指着屋里的大象,等他骑着它离开。

lines.en: : Okay, so you want to make him fess up. Got it. How, though? Because the closest I’ve come involved me dressing up like a schoolgirl and I’m not about to let you borrow my outfit.
lines.zh: : 好,所以你想逼他坦白。懂了。怎么做?因为我离成功最近的一次,是把自己打扮成女高中生——而那身行头我可不会借你。

lines.en: : That’s easy, Imani. So easy that people have been relying on it since the dawn of time.
lines.zh: : 这很简单,Imani。简单到人类有史以来就一直在依赖它。

lines.en: : You don’t mean...
lines.zh: : 你不会是说……

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom41
: We get him really drunk and wait for him to slip up!
lines.zh: : 我们把他灌得烂醉,等他自己露馅!

lines.en: scene rikarinmusicroom42
scene rikarinmusicroom43
: Oh, cool. Mission text.
lines.zh: : 哦,酷。任务短信。
